{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Trovitopolis |characters=ビッグシティ |japanese=Big City |image=The City of Trovitopolis.png |size=250px |region=Orange Islands |epicode=EP102 |episode=The Mystery Menace}} '''Trovitopolis''' (Japanese: '''ビッグシティ''' ''Big City'') is a large port city on the western side of [[Mandarin Island South]]. It featured in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP102|The Mystery Menace]]''. After traveling through the desert in the middle of Mandarin Island South, {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{Tracey}} spotted Trovitopolis from a distance. Before they even reached the city, however, they fell into a hole dug by {{TRT}}. The hole lead them to the sewer system of Trovitopolis where they were confronted with a mysterious creature, which later turned out to be a {{p|Bulbasaur}} that was abandoned by its former owner, the [[Mayor of Trovitopolis]]. The Mayor was concerned about the upcoming elections, but was left publicly humiliated after his secret got out to the public. The ferry to neighboring [[Trovita Island]] runs once a day. The voyage by ferry only takes a few minutes, according to the local [[Officer Jenny]]. ==Places of interest== ===Pokémon Center=== [[File:Trovitopolis Pokémon Center.png|thumb|220px|Trovitopolis Pokémon Center]] {{main|Pokémon Center}} The [[Pokémon Center]] of Trovitopolis is a spherical building built in between two flats. It appears to only have a ground floor. Just like most Pokémon Centers, it features a videophone system to communicate with other people in other [[region]]s or islands. ===Government offices=== The town hall, where the Mayor of Trovitopois works, appears to be a big building built in {{wp|Ancient Roman architecture|ancient Roman style}}. In front of the town hall is a statue of the Mayor of Trovitopolis who was put down in his position after the townspeople heard he had abandoned his Bulbasaur when he was younger. ===Sewer complex=== Beneath Trovitopolis, there is a large sewer complex with a labyrinth of tunnels spanning 500 miles. After the Mayor of Trovitopolis had abandoned his Bulbasaur when he was younger, it ended up living here all on its own. When Ash, Misty, and Tracey ended up in the sewers they were confronted by it, but didn't know it was a Bulbasaur until later. ===Police station=== The police station resembles a large apartment building with a police officer's cap in the middle.
